summary: A searchable Combobox over eight frameworks that prints the selected value below the field.
use: Picking one item from a long list where typing to filter is faster than scrolling a select.
spec: `const frameworks` has 8 options with `value` and `label` keys, from `svelte` to `sveltekit`
`{#if selected}` renders `Selected:` with the value in `<code>`
